# Yuchen Water

Yuchen Water manufactures water filtration components, drinking-water systems and OEM/ODM product platforms in Haining, Zhejiang, China.

## E500-TS-1 (B/W) countertop RO water dispenser

Plumbed-in hot and cold reverse osmosis water dispenser with compressor cooling and intelligent control. OEM/private-label supply and two- or three-outlet configurations can be discussed. English display artwork is a customizable sample.

### Product pages by language
- [English](https://www.yuchensy.com/en/countertop-ro-water-dispenser-e500-ts1.html)
- [Français](https://www.yuchensy.com/fr/countertop-ro-water-dispenser-e500-ts1.html)
- [Deutsch](https://www.yuchensy.com/de/countertop-ro-water-dispenser-e500-ts1.html)
- [Español](https://www.yuchensy.com/es/countertop-ro-water-dispenser-e500-ts1.html)
- [Русский](https://www.yuchensy.com/ru/countertop-ro-water-dispenser-e500-ts1.html)
- [Português](https://www.yuchensy.com/pt/countertop-ro-water-dispenser-e500-ts1.html)
- [العربية](https://www.yuchensy.com/ar/countertop-ro-water-dispenser-e500-ts1.html)

100/200 GPD options; four-stage PP/CTO/RO/T33 filtration; TDS detection; optional IoT/antibacterial customization. See product pages for installation and order-specific limitations.
